"""Final B07 ZIP identity, complete restore, current-source tests and CLI evidence."""
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,subprocess,sys,time,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
BASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DELIVERY=BASE/'b07_delivery';STEM='B07-r1-20261107'
REPORT=DELIVERY/(STEM+'-delivery-verification.json')
def sha(p):
    with Path(p).open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def main():
    report=json.loads(REPORT.read_text());packages=[DELIVERY/x['filename'] for x in report['packages']]
    boot=BASE/'b07_final_bootstrap';boot.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(packages[0]) as z:
        (boot/'restore.py').write_bytes(z.read('fogsim-stage-d-b07/development/b07/restore.py'))
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('b07_restore',boot/'restore.py');helper=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
    restored=helper.restore(packages,BASE/'b07_final_restored',REPORT);root=Path(restored['root'])
    active=json.loads((root/'development/b07/active-files.json').read_text())
    source_checks=[]
    for x in active['files']:
        digest=sha(root/x['path']);assert digest==x['sha256'],x['path']
        source_checks.append(dict(path=x['path'],size=(root/x['path']).stat().st_size,sha256=digest))
    runtime=BASE/'b07_final_runtime';runtime.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join((str(BASE/'b06_review/environment/python-deps'),str(root/'src'),str(root/'tools'))),
        PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',FOGSIM_B07_EVIDENCE=str(runtime/'test-observations'))
    commands=[]
    def run(label,argv):
        start=time.time();p=subprocess.run(list(map(str,argv)),cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
        commands.append(dict(label=label,argv=list(map(str,argv)),cwd=str(root),duration_seconds=time.time()-start,
            environment={k:v for k,v in env.items() if k in ('PYTHONPATH','PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE','FOGSIM_B07_EVIDENCE')},
            exit_code=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr))
        assert p.returncode==0,(label,p.stdout,p.stderr)
    run('final-restored-B07-contracts',[sys.executable,'-m','pytest','tests/stage_d/b07','-q','-ra','-p','no:cacheprovider',
        '--basetemp='+str(runtime/'tmp'),'--junitxml='+str(runtime/'b07.xml')])
    suites=list(ET.parse(runtime/'b07.xml').getroot().iter('testsuite'))
    counts={k:sum(int(s.get(k,0)) for s in suites) for k in ('tests','failures','errors','skipped')}
    assert counts==dict(tests=69,failures=0,errors=0,skipped=0)
    run('final-restored-shared-GP-CLI',[sys.executable,'-m','fogsim','dynamic','--config',
        root/'configs/examples/stage_d_b07_native_shared-fork-join.json','--output',runtime/'shared-cli.json'])
    run('strict-read-final-CLI',[sys.executable,'-c','from fogsim.serialization.result import read_result;import sys;assert read_result(sys.argv[1])["status"]=="SUCCEEDED";print("READ_OK")',runtime/'shared-cli.json'])
    cli=json.loads((runtime/'shared-cli.json').read_text())
    qualifying=[d for d in cli['decisions'] if d['kind']=='SEQUENCING' and len(d['candidates'])>=2
        and len({c['owner_numeric_id'] for c in d['candidate_state']})>=2 and d['selected']!=d['candidates'][0]['option']]
    assert len(qualifying)==5
    baseline=json.loads((root/'development/b06-review/delivery-files.json').read_text())
    old=baseline['files']|{baseline['self_excluded']:dict(sha256='85d9a5f50cfb3a679e61130f7d5b7299371cbf28dbb4834e00c5e6a10a9ed9c4')}
    assert all(sha(root/n)==x['sha256'] for n,x in old.items())
    validation=json.loads((root/'development/b07/validation.json').read_text())
    assert validation['passed'] and validation['batch_complete'] and not validation['B08_implemented'] and not validation['stage_d_complete']
    report.update(passed=True,classification='CONTRACT_CHECK_PASSED',delivery_status='B07_COMPLETE_SCENARIO_ACCEPTANCE_PASSED_PENDING_USER_CONFIRMATION',
        final_restore=restored,final_restored_runtime=dict(passed=True,commands=commands,test_counts=counts,
            junit_xml=(runtime/'b07.xml').read_text(),CLI_result=cli,actual_CLI_multidevice_nonfirst=len(qualifying),
            active_runtime_source_tests_tools_resources_checked=len(source_checks),source_checks=source_checks,
            accepted_B06_members_preserved=len(old),accepted_B06_files_modified=[],
            complete_fresh_JDK17_26_scenarios_and_5659_tests='development/b07/evidence/independent-full',
            repeated_runs_added_to_unique_counts=False),
        final_check_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),part_count=len(packages),
        reason_for_part_count='retain accepted B06 history, all B07 attempts and complete independent recovery evidence; ordinary ZIPs target about40MiB or less',
        B08_implemented=False,stage_d_complete=False,user_device_download_verified=False)
    REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,members=restored['members'],active_hashes=len(source_checks),new_tests=counts,
        actual_CLI_nonfirst=len(qualifying),report_sha256=sha(REPORT)),indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
